checks.title: Independent optical confirmation
checks.finding: optical data from 1 independent source(s): AAVSO observer HMB (7115). One instrument or observer is a single point of failure; seek a second. TESS is not counted: it is normalised per sector, so it confirms an event only if a sector overlaps it, and never its absolute depth.

checks.title: Does AAVSO start at the star's normal brightness?
checks.finding: first 60 days of V: median 14.67; Gaia DR3 (2014-17 mean) implies V = 13.52; difference +1.15 mag. The series begins mid-event: its own median is not the star's normal state.

checks.title: Colour of the variability (all simultaneous AAVSO data)
checks.finding: dB/dV = 1.55 (ISM dust 1.32, r = 0.98), dR/dV = 0.66 (ISM dust 0.81, r = 0.50), dI/dV = 0.46 (ISM dust 0.59, r = 0.94). At least one band does not track V: suspect calibration, a blend, or a band-specific artifact.
